summary: A live-play benchmark: an AI plays Oxygen Not Included one move per turn through a program inside the game, and a milestone counts only when that program reads it from game state.

shown.data: 9 runs in 12 sittings, from the run host's job reports (ZMS-Labs/oni-bench@oni-relay at 4348770cf90cb1fddc813f8945d0cd45c142b626)

limits: Runs were played on different revisions of the test and with different run limits; no model is ranked.
